parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source assays, activities, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures. Join assays.assay_id = activities.assay_id, activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno, molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613769', activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL, activities.standard_relation = '='. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
